title: Kobitz: US recovered multiple craft, including Roswell, Aztec and Kingman

tellings.quote: What he told me was that he'd been told that the United States had recovered multiple craft.

plain: The United States recovered several crashed craft not built by people, among them the ones said to have fallen at Roswell and Aztec in New Mexico and at Kingman in Arizona. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart says a man named Nat Kobitz told him this, and that Kobitz had himself been told it, so it comes to us at second hand twice over. If true, it would mean these crashes were real and more than one craft is held.
